confidence_notes: [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Tampa) informs meal, coffee and beer estimates. Cocktail and wine estimates use beer and [local happy-hour price relationships](https://daddyshappyhour.com/florida/happy-hour-prices) as a guide to regular prices. Lodging is a holistic estimate; hostel availability and July rates are uncertain. Prices are estimated before tax and tips.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Tampa Bay and comparable Florida tourist markets, including St. Petersburg and Orlando, with allowance for July travel patterns.
